description.$value: Link colors of the brand mode CH_marketing. The plain names are for light surfaces, the names with _inverse for dark surfaces. The link tokens point here, so the brand decides the link colors.

default.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, default, light surfaces. CH_marketing: Swiss DS red.

default_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, default, dark surfaces. CH_marketing: red, lighter for contrast.

hover.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, hover, light surfaces. CH_marketing: Swiss DS red.

hover_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, hover, dark surfaces. CH_marketing: red, lighter for contrast.

active.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, active, light surfaces. CH_marketing: Swiss DS red.

active_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, active, dark surfaces. CH_marketing: red, lighter for contrast.

visited.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, visited, light surfaces. CH_marketing: visited interaction color.

visited_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, visited, dark surfaces. CH_marketing: visited interaction color.
